derivation: and (feminine) נַחֲרָה; from an unused root meaning to snort or snore;

occurrences.text: Canst thou make him afraid as a grasshopper? the glory of his nostrils is terrible.

The snorting of his horses was heard from Dan: the whole land trembled at the sound of the neighing of his strong ones; for they are come, and have devoured the land, and all that is in it; the city, and those that dwell therein.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
